title: The Anticipation: Of Peace
speaker: St. Paul's UCC
description: Pastor Mike Roth shared a profound message on "The Anticipation: Of Peace," drawing from the Gospel of Luke. As we lit the candle of peace, we were reminded of the deep and abiding peace that God offers us, even amidst life's storms. Pastor Mike's sermon challenged us to rethink our understanding of peace and encouraged us to embrace it as a gift from God.
